what: List the file structure of the data
title: Introduction to facthelpeR
text: auxiliary_files folder contains helper files used curation process. Generally, *_aux.csvs manually edited match controlled vocabularies. live separate folder output don’t get written accidentally.
code: main_folder <- "inst/extdata/OSU_2019_example" data_folder <- here::here(main_folder, "data-raw") auxiliary_files <- here::here(main_folder, "auxiliary_files")  knitroutput_folder <- here::here(main_folder, "output")

what: Generate a list of all of the files and sheets
title: Introduction to facthelpeR
text: header first row (spans multiple rows), write.csv(sheet_info, ...) manually fill number rows skip sheet. data.frame read read_multsheets()
code: files_csv <- list.files(data_folder, recursive = TRUE, pattern = ".csv")  sheet_info_csv <- data.frame(filename = files_csv) %>%    filter(!str_detect(filename, "curation_files")) %>%   mutate(list_names = basename(filename)) %>%   mutate(list_names = str_remove(list_names, ".csv"))   knitr::kable(sheet_info_csv)

title: Introduction to facthelpeR
text: Use facthelpeR::rm_dup_col() can detect remove duplicates : - column names exact, column contents - difference two column contents one NAs, column removed retained
code: data_raw3 <- imap(data_raw2, function(x,y){     print(y)     rm_dup_col(x, FALSE) %>%      select(where(~!all(is.na(.)))) }) #> [1] "HWEYT_Condon" #> [1] "Removing: rep_dup" #> [1] "HWEYT_Dufur" #> [1] "No columns removed"

code: colnames <- summarize_variables(data_raw3, reg_ex = NULL) colnames_summary <- colnames %>%   group_by(colname) %>%   summarize(across(everything(), ~ paste(na.omit(unique(.x)), collapse = "; ")))  write.csv(colnames_summary, here::here(knitroutput_folder, "colnames_summary.csv"), row.names = FALSE)  knitr::kable(colnames_summary)

title: Introduction to facthelpeR
text: First, understand column means (description units) : checking annual reports checking Julia lastly, asking PI , fill auxiliary file appropriate controlled vocabulary. isn’t corresponding controlled vocabulary, need : decide column can captured current controlled vocabulary. , standardize controlled vocabulary decide whether need keep variable (can fill auxiliary file “rm_col” controlled_vocab column rename.col() remove rm_col argument = TRUE) decide whether new controlled vocabulary added. , add controlled vocabulary using correct formatting, described README (usually get Julia’s opinion , especially adding new vocabularies)
code: colnames_curation <-    read.csv(here::here(auxiliary_files, "colnames_summary_aux.csv")) %>%   # If a column name still needs to be checked/confirmed, leave the controlled_vocab    # column blank in the "colnames_summary_aux.csv" file.     # Before the renaming step, just set the unknowns to the    # original name.   mutate(controlled_vocab =             ifelse(controlled_vocab == "", colname, controlled_vocab))   knitr::kable(colnames_curation) data_raw_rename1 <- rename_col(data_raw3,                                rename_df = colnames_curation,                                rename_col = controlled_vocab,                                old_col = colname,                                rm_col = TRUE) #> [1] "HWEYT_Condon" #> Renaming all data.frames with the same rename values #> Columns renamed 'rm_col' will be removed #> [1] "HWEYT_Dufur" #> Renaming all data.frames with the same rename values #> Columns renamed 'rm_col' will be removed  knitr::kable(head(data_raw_rename1[[1]])) knitr::kable(head(data_raw_rename1[[2]])) save(data_raw_rename1,      file = here::here(knitroutput_folder, "data_raw_rename1.RData"))

what: Some functions that may help explore the columns within the list of data
title: Introduction to facthelpeR
text: often instances column names used consistently files similar column names within one dataset (test vs. testwt). following functions may help summarize explore data. See summarize_variables() used . summarize_ncol() summarize_colnames summarizes information collected summarize_variables() List number columns match given regex per dataset. List proportion files contain given Pull columns match given regex. useful checking see whether column names used consistently within across datasets.
code: cols_summary <- summarize_ncol(data_raw_rename1, c("entry", "length")) knitr::kable(cols_summary) cols_prop <- summarize_colnames(data_raw_rename1, c("entry", "length")) knitr::kable(cols_prop) cols <- select_colsfromlist(data_raw_rename1,  c("entry", "length")) knitr::kable(cols)
